free_tier.stated: A Free plan exists on the members dashboard ('Your Plan - Free - No active plan') with 'higher daily quotas' reserved for Premium. The free allowance itself is not published on any public page read.
free_tier.notes: Per-host pages publish one number, e.g. 'Daily limit: 30 GB' for Rapidgator, without saying which tier it belongs to. A JDownloader board post from a user reports 1 GB/day as a guest; a 2018 review reports 13 hosts for free users. Both are third-party and old, so the free number stays unverified.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: Cocoleech does not host files ('Cocoleech does not host files.')

retention.stated: not applicable: temporary links only. 'Create a temporary accelerated link'.

egress.terms: Transfers run over a '10 Gbps backbone'; per-host daily limits apply and are shown per host. No total monthly byte allowance is published.
egress.free_allowance: unpublished; per-host 'Daily limit' figures such as 30 GB on Rapidgator

interface_detail: Web generator, Chrome and Firefox extensions, and a JDownloader 2 plugin. No public API documented on the pages read.
tooling: JDownloader 2 plugin, Chrome and Firefox extensions. That is the widest first-party tooling of the small providers.
chaining: Its JDownloader plugin makes it the least-friction free generator for a headless client, but at USD 14.99/month it is three to five times the sub-USD-5 providers, so it is a fallback for tooling, not for price.

limits.value: per-host daily limits, e.g. 'Daily limit: 30 GB' on Rapidgator and 'Daily limit: 5 GB' on Filefox
free plan is queued behind premium; 'Higher Quotas' is the advertised premium delta

limits_note: The generator reports 'Maintenance' and 'Daily limit: 30 GB' side by side on the Rapidgator page, so a host can be both limited and degraded.
binding_note: the 30 GB/day Rapidgator cap alone is 900 GB/month.

identity_cost.detail: Premium is a voucher key emailed after payment; checkout is Paddle (card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, iDEAL), PayPal, CoinPayments crypto, Difmark or Paysafecard. No phone and no card are needed for a free account.

reliability_note: A 2021 test by multihosts.de reported that Cocoleech 'completely discontinued its free service' and later pages still show a Free plan, so the free tier's existence has been unstable across years; per-host limits and 'Maintenance' states change without notice.
confidence_note: Prices, the plan structure and the per-host daily limits are from the vendor's own pages. The free allowance is unverified, so the free half of the claim rests on a third-party 2021 report.

evidence.proved: USD 14.99 / 1 month (31 days), USD 29.99 / 3 months ('$9.99/mo equivalent'), USD 79.99 / 1 year ('$6.66/mo equivalent'), one-time payment, no automatic renewals, '10 Gbps backbone'
'Maintenance Daily limit: 30 GB' for Rapidgator, 'Auth: No Rapidgator.net account needed', and the 'Limit reached - Daily quota hit for this host' error text
'Daily limit: 5 GB' on a second host, confirming the cap is per host and not per account
third-party report that in April 2021 'the provider has completely discontinued its free service' (reported, not observed)
user report that a Cocoleech guest can download 'bis zu 1GB/Tag' across hosts (reported)

price_per_tb_month: USD 14.99/month; USD 6.66/month on the annual term
notes: Above USD 5 bar on every term except the annual equivalent, which is still USD 6.66. Recorded because it is the most-cited small multi-hoster in the JDownloader ecosystem and because its per-host daily caps are a worked example of the shape: a total 'unlimited' claim paired with per-host GB/day numbers. Free tier is asserted by the dashboard and contradicted by a 2021 report; both are kept.

extras.tooling: JDownloader 2 plugin, Chrome extension, Firefox extension
